introduction: Hub decides in one place, internal/wsaccess, what access a caller has to a workspace (admin, owner, org member or none) and what each REST endpoint needs (read, write or private). Members of a workspace's organization can read the workspace across hub's REST API. Every change stays with the owner and with admin tokens. The workspace listing returns every workspace the caller may read, and each workspace object carries the caller's access and the org slug.

glossary.Access: wsaccess.Access, the caller's level on one workspace: AccessNone (""), AccessMember ("member"), AccessOwner ("owner") or AccessAdmin ("admin").
glossary.Need: wsaccess.Need, what an endpoint requires. NeedRead: member, owner or admin. NeedWrite: owner or admin, and a member gets 403. NeedPrivate: owner or admin, and a member gets 404.
glossary.RefusalSite: wsaccess.RefusalSite, the status, surface and (optionally) method and route that a bound-refusal report carries. SiteOf(c, 404) builds one from the request.
glossary.bound PAT: A personal access token bound to a single workspace (spec 33). It is refused with 404 on every other workspace, and the refusal is reported (spec 34).
glossary.forbidden refusal: An HTTP 403 in the apikit error envelope with error_type "forbidden" and message "org members have read-only access to this workspace".
glossary.member: A caller with a non-empty UserID who is not the workspace owner, where the workspace's org_id is non-empty and apikit's org_members table has the row (org_id, user_id).
glossary.readable set: The result of wsaccess.ReadableSlugs: every workspace slug the caller may read, mapped to the caller's Access, or all=true for an admin token.
glossary.stranger: A caller with AccessNone on a workspace: not an admin token, not the owner and not a member.

requirements.title: Access levels
requirements.rationale: One ordered rule for every caller replaces the ownership comparisons scattered across handlers.

criteria.action: define type Access string with the constants AccessNone = "", AccessMember = "member", AccessOwner = "owner" and AccessAdmin = "admin"

criteria.condition: the caller's CredentialType is "admin_token"
criteria.action: decide AccessAdmin for every existing workspace without reading org_members
criteria.contract: WorkspaceAccess.Access == "admin"; no query against org_members is issued

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller's UserID is non-empty and equals the workspace's owner_id
criteria.action: decide AccessOwner without reading org_members
criteria.contract: WorkspaceAccess.Access == "owner"; the decision succeeds against a database that has no org_members table

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller with a non-empty UserID is not the workspace's owner
criteria.guard: the workspace's org_id is non-empty and org_members has a row (org_id, UserID), whatever the org's status or kind
criteria.action: decide AccessMember
criteria.contract: WorkspaceAccess.Access == "member"

criteria.condition: the workspace's org_id is NULL or empty, or the caller is not an admin token and has an empty UserID (an admin-role API key with an empty UserID included)
criteria.action: decide AccessNone for every caller other than an admin token and the owner, without reading org_members
criteria.contract: AuthorizeWorkspace answers 404 "workspace not found"

criteria.condition: the org_members row that made a caller a member is deleted
criteria.action: read membership on every request, with no cache, so the caller's next request is decided without the deleted row
criteria.contract: the next AuthorizeWorkspace call for that caller returns 404 "workspace not found"

criteria.action: for any combination of credential type, UserID, owner_id, org_id and org_members rows, decide the Access given by the first rule that matches, in this order: admin token, owner, member, none

requirements.title: Needs and the answers of AuthorizeWorkspace
requirements.rationale: Every endpoint states the need it has, and the shared function turns access and need into one answer.

criteria.action: define type Need string with NeedRead, NeedWrite and NeedPrivate, and expose AuthorizeWorkspace(db *sql.DB, auth *apikit.AuthInfo, slug string, need Need) (*WorkspaceAccess, int, string) and AuthorizeWorkspaceAt(db, auth, slug, need, site RefusalSite) with the same return values. workspace.AuthorizeWorkspace delegates to wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace and takes the same need parameter

criteria.condition: auth is nil
criteria.action: refuse without querying the database
criteria.contract: returns (nil, 401, "authentication required")

criteria.condition: the slug names no workspace, or the caller's access is AccessNone
criteria.action: refuse without a binding lookup and without a bound-refusal report
criteria.contract: returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found"); the bound-refusal observer is called 0 times

criteria.condition: the caller has a non-None access and is a PAT bound to a different workspace (DeniesWorkspace reports a denial)
criteria.action: refuse whatever the caller's access and need, and report the refusal once with the given site. AuthorizeWorkspace uses RefusalSite{Status: 404, Surface: SurfaceAPI}, which has no method or route
criteria.contract: returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found"); exactly one bound-refusal report carrying the site

criteria.condition: the caller's access is AccessMember and the need is NeedWrite or NeedPrivate
criteria.action: refuse after the binding check
criteria.contract: NeedWrite returns (nil, 403, "org members have read-only access to this workspace"); NeedPrivate returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found")

criteria.condition: the caller's access satisfies the need and no binding denies the slug
criteria.action: return the workspace's slug, owner_id, org_id, status, clone_status and the caller's access
criteria.contract: returns (&WorkspaceAccess{Slug, OwnerID, OrgID, Status, CloneStatus, Access}, 0, ""); OrgID is "" when the column is NULL

criteria.condition: reading the workspace row, the org_members row or the token binding fails with a database error
criteria.action: fail closed and never grant access
criteria.contract: returns (nil, 500, "internal server error")

criteria.condition: a handler calls wsaccess.WriteRefusal(c echo.Context, status int, msg string) with a refusal from AuthorizeWorkspace
criteria.action: write the refusal in the apikit error envelope, setting error_type to the exported constant ErrorTypeForbidden ("forbidden") only when status is 403
criteria.contract: 403: body {error: msg, error_type: "forbidden"}; any other status: body {error: msg} with no error_type field

requirements.title: The readable set
requirements.rationale: The listing and the later audit spec need every readable workspace in one query, with the membership rule kept in wsaccess.

criteria.condition: ReadableSlugs(db, auth) is called with an admin token
criteria.action: return unrestricted access without querying the database
criteria.contract: returns (nil, true, nil)

criteria.condition: auth is nil, or the caller is not an admin token and has an empty UserID
criteria.action: return an empty readable set without querying the database
criteria.contract: returns (non-nil empty map, false, nil)

criteria.condition: ReadableSlugs is called by a non-admin caller with a non-empty UserID
criteria.action: return, in one query, every workspace of any status that the caller owns, mapped to AccessOwner, plus every workspace whose org_id is an org the caller belongs to, mapped to AccessMember. A workspace that is both owned and in a member org maps to AccessOwner
criteria.contract: returns (map[slug]Access, false, nil)

criteria.condition: ReadableSlugs is called by a non-admin caller
criteria.guard: the caller is a bound PAT
criteria.action: resolve the binding before opening any result rows, and keep at most the bound slug, and only if it is in the caller's readable set
criteria.contract: returns a map with at most one entry, the bound slug; the call succeeds on a database limited to one open connection

criteria.condition: the binding lookup or the readable-set query fails
criteria.action: return the error to the caller and grant nothing
criteria.contract: returns (nil, false, non-nil error)

criteria.action: for any non-admin caller and any workspace W, include W in ReadableSlugs with access A exactly when AuthorizeWorkspace(db, auth, W, NeedRead) succeeds with WorkspaceAccess.Access == A

requirements.title: The workspace listing
requirements.rationale: A team member needs to find the org's workspaces before reading them.

criteria.condition: an admin token calls GET /api/v1/workspaces
criteria.action: return every workspace as today, filtered by include_archived, ordered by created_at descending
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with a JSON array in which every object has access == "admin"

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller calls GET /api/v1/workspaces
criteria.action: return the workspaces in the caller's ReadableSlugs, excluding archived ones unless include_archived=true, ordered by created_at descending, with no copy of the membership rule in the workspace package
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with a JSON array whose object for each slug has the access recorded in ReadableSlugs ("owner" or "member")

criteria.action: load listed workspaces with a by-slug query (WHERE slug IN (...)) in chunks of at most 500 slugs, and sort the merged result by created_at descending
criteria.contract: a caller with 501 readable workspaces receives all 501, in created_at descending order

criteria.condition: the caller has an empty readable set
criteria.action: return an empty listing
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body []

criteria.condition: a PAT without a read-implying workspace scope calls GET /api/v1/workspaces
criteria.action: refuse before ReadableSlugs is called, as today
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found"

criteria.condition: a PAT calls GET /api/v1/workspaces
criteria.guard: the PAT is bound to a workspace
criteria.action: list at most the bound workspace, and only if the PAT's user may read it
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with an array of zero or one object

criteria.condition: ReadableSlugs or the by-slug query returns an error
criteria.action: return no workspaces
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 "internal server error"

requirements.title: Workspace objects carry access and org_slug
requirements.rationale: A client needs to know what it may do with each workspace it can see.

criteria.action: add the fields access and org_slug to every workspace object rendered by the create, get, list, update, archive, reactivate, sync (carry-patch extras included) and reclone responses
criteria.contract: each of these response bodies has the keys "access" and "org_slug"

criteria.action: set access to the caller's level as decided by wsaccess ("admin", "owner" or "member"), whatever the PAT's scopes, and set it to "owner" in the create response
criteria.contract: a PAT holding only workspaces:read, used by the owner, sees access == "owner"

criteria.condition: a workspace object is rendered
criteria.action: set org_slug to the slug of the org row named by the workspace's org_id, reusing the org lookup that builds hub_url
criteria.contract: org_slug is the org's slug string, or JSON null when org_id is NULL or no org row has that id

criteria.action: for any workspace, render the same set of keys and values for a member as for the owner, hub_url included, apart from the value of access, and render no field that holds a credential value

requirements.title: Workspace, sync and patch routes
requirements.rationale: The workspace package's inline ownership check becomes a call to the shared rule.

criteria.action: take a Need, get its decision from wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspaceAt with SiteOf(c, 404), and then load the full workspace row, without comparing owner_id itself
criteria.contract: the decision and its status and message are the ones AuthorizeWorkspaceAt returns

criteria.condition: a member, through a PAT holding the scope each route needs today or through a non-PAT credential, calls GET /workspaces/:slug, GET /workspaces/:slug/patches or GET /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id
criteria.action: serve the read as for the owner
criteria.contract: HTTP 200; the workspace object has access == "member"

criteria.condition: a member calls PATCH /workspaces/:slug, POST /workspaces/:slug/archive, POST /workspaces/:slug/reactivate, DELETE /workspaces/:slug, POST /workspaces/:slug/sync, POST /workspaces/:slug/reclone, POST /workspaces/:slug/patches, PATCH /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id, DELETE /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id, POST /workspaces/:slug/patches/reorder, POST /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id/restore or POST /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id/reset-to-origin
criteria.action: refuse with NeedWrite and change no row, no git ref and no job queue entry
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 forbidden refusal (error_type "forbidden")

criteria.condition: the workspace row is deleted between the access decision and the full-row load
criteria.action: refuse
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found"

criteria.condition: a PAT bound to another workspace reaches lookupWorkspaceForAuth
criteria.action: refuse and report the refusal once with the request's method and route, as spec 34 requires (TS-34-58)
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found"; one bound-refusal report whose site carries the request method and route

requirements.title: Carry-patch and merge routes
requirements.rationale: Members of a team need to see each other's rebuilds, rerere state and merges.

criteria.action: pass a Need from authorizeWorkspace, authorizeMergeWorkspace and validateWorkspaceForMerge to AuthorizeWorkspace, and write their refusals with wsaccess.WriteRefusal

criteria.condition: a member with the scope each route needs today calls GET .../rebuilds, GET .../rebuilds/:id, GET .../rebuild-preview, GET .../patch-status, GET .../rerere, GET .../merges or GET .../merges/:id
criteria.action: serve the read with NeedRead, as for the owner
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the body the owner gets

criteria.condition: a member calls POST .../rebuild, DELETE .../rebuilds/:id, POST .../rebuilds/:id/requeue, POST .../rebuilds/:id/rollback, DELETE .../rerere/*, POST .../merges, DELETE .../merges/:id, POST .../merges/:id/requeue or POST .../rebase
criteria.action: refuse with NeedWrite and enqueue, cancel or delete nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 forbidden refusal (error_type "forbidden"); the job queue and the rerere cache are unchanged

criteria.condition: runCarryPatchSync authorizes the workspace
criteria.action: use NeedWrite
criteria.contract: a member gets HTTP 403 forbidden refusal; an owner gets today's answer

requirements.title: Sandbox lease and forge routes
requirements.rationale: Members need to see the workspace's sandboxes and its forge state. Issuing, deleting and forge writes stay with the owner.

criteria.action: map the lease authorize write flag to NeedWrite when true and NeedRead when false, and map the forge access values readAccess to NeedRead and writeAccess and writeAnyStatusAccess to NeedWrite

criteria.condition: a member with the read scope calls GET .../sandboxes or GET .../sandboxes/:id
criteria.action: return the lease bodies the owner gets, including their secrets and optional_secrets names, unredacted
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the same body as the owner's request

criteria.condition: a member calls POST .../sandboxes or DELETE .../sandboxes/:id
criteria.action: refuse, issuing or destroying no lease and calling no sandbox backend
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 forbidden refusal (error_type "forbidden")

criteria.condition: a member with forge:read calls GET .../forge, .../forge/repository, .../forge/deliveries, .../issues, .../issues/:n, .../issues/:n/comments, .../pulls/:n, .../pulls/:n/state, .../pulls/:n/files, .../pulls/:n/checks or .../pulls/:n/reviews
criteria.action: serve the read with the workspace's configured forge credential, as for the owner
criteria.contract: HTTP 200; the credential field is only its kind and no response body contains the credential's value

criteria.condition: a member calls POST .../issues, PATCH .../issues/:n, POST .../issues/:n/close, POST .../issues/:n/comments, POST .../issues/:n/labels, DELETE .../issues/:n/labels/:name, POST .../labels, POST .../pulls, POST .../pulls/:n/comments, PUT .../forge/webhook or DELETE .../forge/webhook
criteria.action: refuse without calling the forge and without changing the webhook configuration
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 forbidden refusal (error_type "forbidden"); 0 outbound forge requests

requirements.title: Secrets, variables and bound tokens
requirements.rationale: A member reads the workspace's variables but never sees its secrets or its tokens.

criteria.action: replace lookupWorkspaceOwner and lookupWorkspaceForResolution with wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace, and write every workspace refusal with wsaccess.WriteRefusal
criteria.contract: a stranger on any workspace secret or variable route gets HTTP 404 {error: "workspace not found"} in the apikit envelope

criteria.condition: a member calls POST or GET .../secrets, or PATCH or DELETE .../secrets/:key
criteria.action: refuse with NeedPrivate, change nothing, and reveal no secret name
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found", the same body a stranger gets

criteria.condition: a member calls GET .../vars
criteria.action: list the workspace's variables with NeedRead, as for the owner
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the body the owner gets

criteria.condition: a member calls GET .../vars/resolved
criteria.action: resolve with the owner's user tier, the org tier only when the owner is still a member of the workspace's org, and the workspace tier
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the same document the owner gets

criteria.condition: a member calls POST .../vars, PATCH .../vars/:key or DELETE .../vars/:key
criteria.action: refuse with NeedWrite and change no variable
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 forbidden refusal (error_type "forbidden")

criteria.condition: a member calls POST .../tokens or GET .../tokens
criteria.action: refuse through AuthorizeWorkspace with NeedPrivate in place of its own owner comparison, minting no token and listing none
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found" (TS-34-6 unchanged)

criteria.condition: a bound PAT or an admin token calls POST .../tokens
criteria.action: refuse before the workspace lookup, with the answers and reports spec 34 defines
criteria.contract: the same status, body and refusal report as before this spec

requirements.title: What does not change
requirements.rationale: Widening read access must not move any existing answer for owners, admins, strangers or bound tokens.

criteria.action: run the access step exactly where the ownership step runs today: after the PAT scope check and after any body validation that precedes it today (as in PATCH /workspaces/:slug), and before workspace status and precondition checks
criteria.contract: a member PATCH, merge, rebuild or forge write on an archived or inactive workspace gets HTTP 403, not 400

criteria.condition: a PAT without the scope a route needs calls any route in this spec
criteria.action: refuse with the scope answer of today before the workspace is looked up, whatever the caller's membership
criteria.contract: workspace CRUD routes: HTTP 404; the other routes: the 403 without an error_type that they return today

criteria.action: for any route in this spec and any stranger, return the same status and body as before this spec
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found" (secrets and variables: now in the wsaccess wording)

criteria.action: give an owner or an admin token the same status and body as before this spec on every route, apart from the added access and org_slug fields, so that every existing ownership test for a workspace in a personal org passes with fixture changes only

criteria.condition: a PAT bound to workspace A, whose user is a member of the org of workspace B, calls any route of B
criteria.action: refuse through the unchanged BindingGuard, apikit route guard or binding check, and report the refusal as spec 34 does
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 "workspace not found"; the same bound-refusal reports as before this spec

criteria.condition: a member calls a session, cost, audit, SSE or transcript route of the workspace, or the git server
criteria.action: keep the owner-only checks of today
criteria.contract: the member gets the same status and body as a stranger did before this spec

execution_paths.title: An org member finds and reads a teammate's workspace

steps.action: calls GET /api/v1/workspaces with an API key
call wsaccess.ReadableSlugs, which returns W mapped to AccessMember because U2 has an org_members row for W's org O
loads W by slug and the handler returns 200 with W carrying access "member" and org_slug O
AuthorizeWorkspaceAt with NeedRead decides AccessMember and grants

execution_paths.title: An org member's write is refused and nothing changes

steps.action: passes the scope check, then calls AuthorizeWorkspace with NeedWrite
decides AccessMember and returns 403 "org members have read-only access to this workspace"
writes the refusal through WriteRefusal with error_type forbidden and enqueues no rebuild job

execution_paths.title: An org member is shown no secret and no token of the workspace

steps.action: decides AccessMember and returns 404 "workspace not found" for both
receives the same 404 body a stranger receives, with no secret name and no token

execution_paths.title: A removed member loses read access on the next request

steps.action: calls GET /api/v1/workspaces/W and receives 200 with access "member"
deletes U2's org_members row for org O
reads org_members, finds no row, decides AccessNone and returns 404 "workspace not found"
